tools.name: resolve_identity
tools.description: Resolve an ECZ-ID through the public ECZ-ID Resolver and return the exact canonical state with checked_at, Resolver proof link, re-check action and the local-policy caveat. Never asserts safety, approval or compliance.

tools.name: get_current_state
tools.description: Return the narrow current Resolver-derived state for an ECZ-ID (state, checked_at, Resolver link). No risk/safety/compliance inference.

tools.name: get_resolver_link
tools.description: Return the deterministic public Resolver proof/re-check URL for an ECZ-ID. No network call.

tools.name: explain_status
tools.description: Deterministically render the exact ECZ-ID status using the claims-safe renderer (VERIFIED is an ECZ-ID state, not a Microsoft certification). Absence of evidence renders the approved neutral wording — never "unsafe". No LLM.

tools.name: find_product
tools.description: Given narrow context flags, return ONE best next ECZ-ID product action (free/community routes win where correct; neutral context routes to free public verification).

tools.name: get_install_instructions
tools.description: Return deterministic official install/discovery routes for an ECZ-ID product or surface (canonical URLs only; planned Microsoft surfaces carry no URLs).

tools.name: create_request_to_resolve
tools.description: AUTHENTICATED: create a neutral, shareable request for independently re-checkable ECZ-ID evidence. Requires a Microsoft Entra bearer token with the RequestToResolve.Create scope (or app role). It never verifies a target, never sends messages, and absence of evidence is never rendered as unsafe.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_request_to_resolve" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
